##### Project general facts

Barari Gate by ADE is a contemporary residential building designed to elevate everyday living through balanced design, practical architecture and community-focused amenities. The project offers studios, one-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom apartments with a maid's room and three-bedroom apartments with a maid's room and private pool, along with retail shops at ground level. A welcoming lobby with high ceilings, natural light and premium finishes sets the tone for residents and guests.

Amenities support an active and social lifestyle throughout the day. An infinity pool with surrounding sunbeds sits alongside a dedicated kids' pool, while indoor and outdoor gyms, a yoga area, a sauna and a jacuzzi cover fitness and recovery. Sports facilities include a basketball court, a padel court and jogging and cycling tracks. Families benefit from indoor and outdoor play areas for children, and a business centre, a billiards and table tennis lounge and shared indoor and outdoor common areas add space for work and socialising.

Interiors are bright and functional, combining premium finishes, natural light and practical layouts across living rooms, bedrooms and bathrooms. Kitchens are fitted with appliances, quality finishes and ample storage for everyday cooking and entertaining. Bathrooms feature refined fittings and a neutral palette. An integrated smart home system allows residents to control lighting, climate, security and curtains with ease.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan, part of Wadi Al Safa, is a growing residential community in the heart of Dubailand, designed as a calmer and greener alternative to the city's core. The area combines family-friendly neighbourhoods with well-planned infrastructure, and sits close to the green landscapes of Al Barari and several of Dubai's best-known leisure destinations. Nearby schools, parks, retail and healthcare facilities make everyday routines simple.

Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure, Dubai Miracle Garden and Al Barari are all close to the community, and Dubai Hills Mall is a short drive away. Major road links provide straightforward connections to Downtown Dubai, the Burj Khalifa, the Museum of the Future and Dubai International Airport, while Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah and Al Maktoum International Airport are also within reach.

Majan is a freehold area that appeals to families and professionals looking for more space at accessible entry points compared with central districts. The growing residential base and the proximity to major attractions support steady rental demand, while well-planned community infrastructure supports long-term value. The area suits both end users seeking a quieter address and investors focused on rental income.
